monument-grotesk-custom.$description: The single voice of the brand — headlines, body, buttons, nav, and tags all use this custom geometric grotesque. Weight 800 for monumental display, 500 for medium emphasis, 400 for body and UI. The tight 0.90 leading on large sizes is a signature: type compresses into architectural blocks instead of airy editorial columns.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Code-like monospace used for pill tags, small status badges, and technical microcopy. The mono voice deliberately contrasts the rounded geometric grotesque, signaling 'system' or 'label' rather than 'message'.

system-ui-sans.$description: Fallback and accessibility text where Monument Grotesk is unavailable; also used for non-brand secondary text and link rendering in card surfaces
